dakkhitāye.p: [Disa+tāye.(moga-5] (kri,vi) CL=10 See-61.) It can see another morphological form, in Nīti, Pada-211.] (A) To see; To meet. (2) To look. See-Dī-2, 2va3. Saṃ-1,25, dī,ṭṭha-2,273, saṃ,ṭṭha-1,72, suttani,ṭṭha-2,92.
